timeline.title: Netanyahu's Bloc Leads Israeli Election, But Majority Remains Elusive
timeline.summary: As of the latest counts, Netanyahu's right-wing bloc is leading the Israeli election but is falling short of the 61 seats needed for a majority in the Knesset. With over 85% of the votes counted, projections indicate that Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to secure around 53 seats, while the opposing coalition led by Eisenkot is expected to gain approximately 48 seats, alongside 19 seats for Arab-led parties. The results suggest a potential deadlock, prompting calls from President Isaac Herzog to avoid another election.
